''See also: [[Silent King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King is a [[Dreadgod]], an entity of immense power that exists as one of the most significant beings in the world. Though often perceived by mortals as the weakest among its siblings, it is actually a formidable force capable of projecting illusions that can engage [[Monarchs]] in combat. Physically, the creature is described as a relatively small white tiger with an oversized halo, though it possesses a massive spiritual influence that can be felt for hundreds of miles. Its primary and most dangerous capability is its mental assault, which allows it to reach into the minds of dreamers across the planet. The Silent King maintains a vast kingdom within a jungle, where it oversees a complex mental web. Its subjects include spirits, remnants, and various creatures that exhibit higher levels of intelligence and social structure than would naturally be expected due to the King's influence. The entity is also associated with a cult known as the [[Silent Servants]], who are characterized as spies and liars capable of brainwashing others. For a long period, the Silent King was sealed away by [[Emriss Silentborn]], the [[Remnant]] [[Monarch]]. However, it was eventually killed by [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]]. Following its death, various remnants of its power remained, including the Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker{{!}}Silent King Bow and a crown that serves as an amplifier for power.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King is a [[giant]] white tiger featuring black stripes and smooth pale skin. This entity possesses a halo that shines as bright as the sun and wears white crowns.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A subtle and insidious [[Dreadgod]], this entity maintains its mental faculties and seeks revenge against [[Emriss Silentborn]]. It exerts control over people like helpless puppets and refers to intruders as bold.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This [[Dreadgod]] utilizes [[hunger madra]], a parasitic [[technique]], and the ability to control the minds of the masses. Its deadliest power is mental assault, which includes using illusions and illusory clones that can be solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The battle of Moongrave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|During the battle of [[Moongrave]], the Silent King's [[dream technique]] washed over the area as his will and various techniques were present in the conflict.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> A halo accompanies this figure, who possesses the ability to use techniques to control the minds of the masses.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16" /> After ordering the [[Golds]] to go wild within the city, he exerted greater control over [[Remnants]] and possessed members of [[Redmoon Hall]] to bolster their [[willpower]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> His thralls attempted to attack [[Yerin]] while his army fought in the distance.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> [[Lindon]] identified the [[Dreadgod]]'s halo as the Silent King, a small [[Dreadgod]] considered the weakest of his kind.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> Appearing as a [[giant]] white tiger with smooth pale skin and black stripes, the [[Dreadgod]]'s face resembles a detailed [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> His crown shines as brightly as the sun, and while his [[madra]] can be identified by eating it, his deadliest power is a mental assault.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> [[Lindon]] eventually sees the victory of this figure in a dream.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Death and legacy}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Silent King, a [[Dreadgod]] previously slain by [[Lindon]], was nearing death.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> This entity possessed [[madra]] capable of fueling illusions and potentially divining the future.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> The Silent King utilized specific techniques involving illusory clones and could produce illusions of its own.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref> Although the [[Void Sage]] eventually killed the Silent King, [[Lindon]] intended to use its [[core binding]] to craft a [[Divine Treasure]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /> The power of the Silent King ultimately corrupted [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c24">''Dreadgod'', chapter 24</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Silent King's remains}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After [[Lindon]] consumed the Silent King, he gained access to a [[spirit]] composed of various materials such as tendons and bones.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> These materials were utilized to craft [[Lindon]]'s special arrows and purple orbs, while the entity's modified [[madra]] served to stimulate [[Lindon]]'s [[Dreadgod arm]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The [[Silent King's madra]] produces [[white light]] and can be used to project illusions that are solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> Following the death of the Silent King, which empowered the [[Weeping Dragon]], the entity was forced to swap places with the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> The Silent King is associated with a halo that acts as a [[Goldsign]] for the [[Silent Servants]], and the [[scale]] of [[Dross]]'s [[dream aura]] once temporarily matched the entity.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]]'s [[Dreadgod arm]] is stimulated by the [[Silent King]]’s modified [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] uses a [[Silent King]] illusion.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] has [[madra]] that produces [[white light]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] can project illusions solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon was empowered by the death of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] has died.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] used materials from the [[Silent King]] to create purple orbs.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] was forced to swap places with the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon's [[binding]] is more like a normal [[binding]] than the [[Silent King]]’s.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] is associated with a halo that serves as a [[Goldsign]] for the [[Silent Servants]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[scale]] of [[Dross]]'s [[dream aura]] temporarily matched the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|After challenging the wards of Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, the Silent King suffered a defeat.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> The pure-[[white halo]] of the Silent King is worn by [[Dross]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> [[Kahn Mala]] previously served as the cult leader for the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 8</ref> The [[Wandering Titan]] eventually traded places with the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Silent King]] challenged the wards of Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius and was defeated.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Dross]] wears the pure-[[white halo]] of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Kahn Mala]] was the former cult leader of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Silent King]] was traded places with by the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“The Silent King is theoretically the most vulnerable of the Dreadgods, yet we were no more successful in damaging it there than anywhere else.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“The Silent King’s body is in hiding,” Emriss continued,<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Silent King’s voice from the door was amused. “Intruders. How bold.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“Lindon,” the Silent King whispered into his mind, “I keep my promises.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“The Silent King can exert greater control over Remnants,” the Sage said.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" />}}
